title.name: Mentor networks and the personal board

overview.description: Relationship mapping, maintaining weak ties, giving before asking, and building a personal board of directors that is not your cap table.
objectives: Assemble five people you can ask a hard question without consequence
Maintain weak ties at a sustainable cost
Give before asking, consistently enough that it is not a tactic
prerequisites: Orientation: how to read this tree

steps.intro: Relationship mapping, maintaining weak ties, giving before asking, and building a personal board of directors that is not your cap table.
instructions: Name your five. If any seat is empty, find it in the mentor directory.
Book one office-hours slot this week with someone outside your discipline.
Do one unprompted useful thing for someone in the cohort.

submission.description: No named deliverable. Work the steps and keep the notes with the module in Homeroom.
